title: ChamferFeature
description: Parametric Chamfer feature: bevels selected edges. Supports equal-distance, two-distance, and distance-and-angle modes. Mesh bevel is a basic approximation. Intended for manufacturing (edge breaking, tool access, aesthetics).

mode.description: Chamfer style: equal distance on both faces, two independent distances, or one distance + angle.

distance.description: Primary chamfer distance: numeric value or parameter name / expression string. Positive.

distance2.description: Secondary distance for two_distance mode (or ignored). Numeric or parameter. Positive.

angle.description: Angle in degrees for distance_angle mode. Numeric or parameter.

edges.description: Optional list of edge identifiers or mesh edge indices to chamfer. Empty or omitted means all edges (or deferred selection).

operation.description: Intent: modify the current solid by chamfering edges.
